repo.name: ant-design
repo.description: An enterprise-class UI design language and React UI library

readme.summary: Excellent top-level README with clear identity, multi-package-manager install instructions, and a minimal usage example, but relies heavily on external links for configuration, examples, and troubleshooting rather than including them inline.
readme.top_issue: No inline configuration or troubleshooting content — common issues like theme setup, tree-shaking, and SSR configuration are only discoverable via external links.

common_complaints: React 18 UMD build incompatibility (works only with React 19)
Table rendering bugs with fixed columns and scrolling
Deprecated Collapse.Panel API lacks feature parity with items API
praise_themes: Some issues attract multiple comments and discussion
sentiment.summary: Community health is concerning: numerous recent issues (Dec 2025-Jan 2026) are marked 'Inactive' despite engagement, critical React 18 compatibility bug remains unresolved after 3 months with 13 comments, and feature requests lack clear prioritization or response from maintainers.

communication.summary: The maintainer's responses are somewhat helpful but lack clarity, patience, technical depth, and welcomingness towards new contributors.

concerns: 1358 open issues with zero closed in past 6 months
No commits in past 6 months despite large issue backlog
No active contributors in past 6 months
No merged pull requests in past 6 months
maintenance.summary: Project is effectively abandoned with massive untriaged issue backlog and zero maintenance activity over 6 months.
